reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: Doesn't work well for me. Been spacing it out every 2/3 days, but skin dries out and starts flaking. Was putting on as last step as well.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講冇咩效果。我已經隔 2 至 3 日先用一次，但皮膚都係會變乾同甩皮。就算我已經當作最後一步用都係咁。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: My favourite product over all i started using retionol on my face at first with a different product called differin i had forgotten about my eye freckles so i looked like a panda for awhile this helps to speed up the process of getting rid of the freckles very gentle to jusy perfect
reviews.zh: 整體嚟講係我最鍾意嘅產品。我一開始係用另一款叫 differin 嘅產品將 retinoid 搽上面，之前我完全唔記得咗眼周有斑，搞到有段時間睇落好似熊貓咁。呢款產品就可以加快淡斑嘅過程，非常溫和，剛剛好，完美。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I’m liking this eye cream so far obviously you need to keep using to see a lasting effect and I’ve only been using it for about two weeks but it’s great so far. It’s not irritating and feels hydrating.
reviews.zh: 暫時我幾鍾意呢款眼霜，睇得出要持續用先見到持久嘅效果，我先用咗大概兩個禮拜，但到目前為止都好好用。唔刺激，感覺有保濕。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I’ve been using this eye cream consistently at night and it has become one of my favorite retinol products. The texture is rich but absorbs well and doesn’t leave a greasy film. I have sensitive skin around my eyes and was worried about irritation, but I only experienced mild tingling the first few uses. Over time I’ve noticed smoother under-eye texture, less creasing with concealer, and overall brighter looking eyes in the morning. It layers nicely with my moisturizer and makeup doesn’t pill on top. I also appreciate that a little goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than expected. Great option if you want anti-aging benefits without harsh dryness.
reviews.zh: 我每晚都持續用緊呢款眼霜，佢已經成為我最鍾意嘅 retinol 產品之一。質地豐厚但吸收得好，唔會留低油笠嘅薄膜。我眼周皮膚屬於敏感肌，本來好擔心會刺激，但頭幾次用只係有輕微刺刺嘅感覺。用落去見到眼周膚質變得平滑咗，上遮瑕膏冇咁摺紋，朝早望落眼周都光亮咗。佢同保濕霜一齊用都好夾，上面再上妝都唔會搓泥。仲有少少就夠用，所以支裝比預期襟用好多。想有抗老效果又唔想皮膚乾到爆，呢款係好選擇。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I had been looking for an eye contour that would help me with fine lines, and at the same time moisturize me, but I was afraid because I have extra sensitive skin, but this product I even use it in my morning routine and it goes great, it goes very well with makeup, does not clog, and above all does not irritate me. Of course, always use sunscreen after use.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款眼霜可以幫我改善細紋同時又保濕，但我皮膚特別敏感所以好驚，不過呢款產品我連早上護膚都會用，夾到不得了，同化妝品都好夾，唔會塞毛孔，最重要係唔會刺激我。當然，用完一定要搽防曬。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I first received this product obviously fell in love. I use it under my eyes before my make up and going to bed. Very moisturizing under the eyes and feels so light weight compared to my other under eye creams
reviews.zh: 我第一次收到呢款產品即刻愛上。化妝前同睡前都會搽喺眼周。眼周保濕做得好好，比起我其他眼霜感覺輕盈好多。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text: I hadn't used this retinol for the eye area yet, I used it yesterday, it didn't sensitize my eyes, it looks good, I was just a little sad because I bought several products and the store didn't even send a sample so I could test other products
reviews.zh: 我之前未用過針對眼周嘅 retinol，琴日先用咗，冇令到我眼周敏感，效果睇落唔錯，只係有少少失望，因為我買咗幾款產品但店家連一個 sample 都冇送俾我試其他產品。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Retinol Intense Advanced Triple Action Eye Cream 30mL
reviews.text:
I have only started using this retinol eye cream, but I have noticed increased hydration and plumping under my eyes after using it for three weeks. No irritation and my skin barrier has stayed intact. 
So far loving this product!!!
reviews.zh:
我啱啱開始用呢款 retinol 眼霜，但用咗三個禮拜之後已經見到眼周保濕度提升咗，皮膚都飽滿返。冇刺激，皮膚屏障都 keep 住完好。
暫時好鍾意呢款產品！！！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
